_INSTRUCTIONS: Copy this file to config.json (in the same folder) and fill in your values.
Do NOT rename this file — the tool reads config.json, not config.example.json.

notes.aoi_shapefile: Full path to your shapefile (.shp). Use forward slashes (C:/...). If the shapefile has multiple features (polygons), a separate mosaic is created for each one.
notes.output_folder: Folder where results (GDB files) will be saved. It will be created automatically if it does not exist. Use a local drive with enough free space.
notes.start_date: Start of the date range to search for Sentinel-2 scenes. Format: YYYY-MM-DD
notes.end_date: End of the date range. Format: YYYY-MM-DD
notes.cloud_cover: Maximum cloud cover percentage to accept (0 = clear sky only, 100 = any). Recommended: 5-15.
notes.area_name: Optional prefix added to all output mosaic names. E.g. 'KSA' produces KSA_Feature_1, KSA_Field_A. Leave empty string for no prefix.
notes.mrf_cache_folder: Local folder used as a tile cache. Leave as default unless you need to change the drive. Must have several GB of free space.
notes.name_field: Optional: a field in your shapefile to use as the mosaic name (e.g. 'FieldName'). Leave as empty string to auto-name as Feature_1, Feature_2, ...
notes.best_scene_only: true = keep only the single best (lowest cloud cover) Sentinel-2 tile per location, giving a clean non-overlapping mosaic. false = keep all scenes in the date range.
notes.months: Optional: restrict scenes to specific months. E.g. [6,7,8] for June, July, August only. Leave as [] to include all months in the date range.
